Why people love us

Locally sourced

Beans, milk and vegetables come from farms within 50 km of our door.

Baked every morning

Made for everyone

Step-free entry, large-print menus and vegan, gluten-free and nut-free options.

Our story

We started in 2015 as a small neighbourhood stall. Today we serve fresh coffee, healthy meals and baked goods every day, using ingredients from nearby farms. We believe good food should be simple, honest and easy for everyone to enjoy.
